connector.name: MCP by neuronsearchlab.com
connector.registryDescription: Recommendations, search, catalogue, analytics, and platform admin tools for NeuronSearchLab
connector.summary: Hosted at console.neuronsearchlab.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.neuronsearchlab, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <NSL API key>. Optional — the endpoint also supports OAuth sign-in via discovery.

env.name: NSL_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OAuth client ID for public mode (SDK Credentials from console → Security).

env.name: NSL_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: OAuth client secret for public mode.

env.name: NSL_PLATFORM_MODE
env.description: Set to 'internal' for admin-platform tools with an API key; defaults to 'public'.

env.name: NSL_API_KEY
env.description: NSL API key (nsl_...) for internal mode.
